format-instagram-curriculum-en: Happy to help! The course has 10 modules over 6 weeks, from wedging and centering to glazing and firing, plus 2 live Q&As. Every lesson is listed week by week at example.com/curriculum. It's 180 EUR with lifetime access.

format-messenger-de-hotel-room-table: Guten Tag! Die Preise pro Nacht inklusive Frühstück: Einzelzimmer 89 EUR, Doppelzimmer 129 EUR, Familienzimmer 169 EUR. Dazu kommt eine Kurtaxe von 3 EUR pro Person und Nacht. Für wie viele Personen möchten Sie buchen?

grounded-ecommerce-return-window-en: Yes, you can. You have 30 days from delivery to return it, as long as it is unused and in the original packaging. Since you are in Germany, just use the prepaid label in the parcel. Your refund goes back to the original payment method 5-7 business days after we receive it.

You can opt in to a sale alert at example.com/alerts, or just message us here on Friday morning.

sales-saas-parcelly-plan-en: Hi! For about 400 parcels a month, Growth fits best: 59 USD per month with 1,000 labels, 5 users and the returns portal. Starter only includes 100 labels. There is a 14-day free trial with no card needed. Do you handle returns yourselves at the moment?
